upstream.notes: Army and FEMA PDFs. These publishers move files between portals fairly often, so an unreachable URL here is a normal finding, not a crisis: validate_manifest.py --network catches it and the pack keeps serving its last good build.

notes: Public domain (US Government works): hostable and modifiable, credited anyway. Some Army PDFs are scanned rather than text; build_pdf_pack.py counts pages with no extractable text and fails the build if nothing extracted at all. It does no OCR.
